# ReadAware

> ReadAware is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0), local-first ebook reader for macOS, Windows, Linux, and Android. It reads DRM-free EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ, CBR, TXT, HTML, and PDF directly. Offline reading, highlights, and notes need no account. Optional AI builds reading memory and sends relevant text to your selected remote model provider: BYOK requires no ReadAware AI subscription, but provider charges may apply. Optional sync is end-to-end encrypted; free accounts include 50 MB, paid plans expand storage, and Pro/Max include built-in AI. Local storage does not mean AI inference is offline.

## Docs

- [Plans and pricing](https://readaware.app/pricing/): free reader, 50 MB free sync, paid storage and built-in AI
- [Privacy](https://readaware.app/privacy/): local storage, encrypted sync, remote AI processing, and website measurement

- [Overview](https://readaware.app/docs/): what ReadAware is and how the pieces fit together
- [Download & install](https://readaware.app/docs/install/): installers for macOS, Windows, Linux, and Android
- [Getting started](https://readaware.app/docs/getting-started/): import books, read, highlight, and talk to the assistant
- [Plugin system](https://readaware.app/docs/plugins/): sandboxed plugins and the built-in marketplace
- [Plugin API reference](https://readaware.app/docs/plugins/api/): the public plugin API surface
- [Publishing plugins](https://readaware.app/docs/plugins/publishing/): how to submit a plugin to the marketplace
